features: paired forebody canards ahead of broad delta main wings
J-20.evidence_scope: gross external layout; user corpus illustration visually checked; no exact proportions certified

features: small forebody canards ahead of delta main wings

cloud_ink.stitch: Fine mixed-thread cloud fields, flat aircraft fills, slim navy rim.

red_charge.name: 红橙冲刺

red_charge.stitch: Flat directional thread regions; slim red rim.
red_charge.forbidden: copied slogans, flames around every edge

night_contrast.name: 夜色剪影
night_contrast.palette: black/graphite, cyan highlights, navy aircraft shadow
night_contrast.stitch: Low-relief fills, selective satin contours, slim charcoal rim.

poses.dorsal_left: Nose upper-left; shallow side/dorsal three-quarter, long slim fuselage; near wing below the spine, far wing shortened above it.
poses.dorsal_right: Nose upper-right; shallow side/dorsal three-quarter, long slim fuselage; near wing below the spine, far wing shortened above it.
poses.banking_left: Nose upper-left in a shallow banking three-quarter view; keep model-specific wing/tail counts readable, not top-view symmetry.
poses.side_left: Near-side elevated view, nose left, almost horizontal; expose target wing profile and tail arrangement.

common.carrier: One complete point-up hexagonal cloth patch, slim stitched rim.
common.simplification: Use three dominant aircraft tones and one canopy mark; omit panel seams.
common.hierarchy: Balance aircraft, negative space and glyphs; maintain margins.
common.presentation: Front-facing white studio product photo, thin textile relief, square image.
common.avoid: tracing, relabeled replicas, copied full layouts, hybrid aircraft, extra text, mascots, molded relief
common.region_stitches: Directional fill on aircraft/background; compact satin only on glyphs and outer rim.

measurements: Visual design starting ranges estimated from the provided samples; not pixel annotations or factory specifications.
reference_strategy: multi-example collection synthesis; subject identity separate from freely designed composition, background and typography; no single-image reconstruction

compositions.climb_offset: Off-center rising aircraft on the right; S-shaped negative-space corridor on the left; no horizontal field split.
compositions.banking_cove: Banking aircraft upper-left; broad curved counterforms form an open asymmetrical cove around it.
compositions.intercept_fan: Near-horizontal aircraft lower-middle; off-center angular ray fan behind one wing; quiet upper corner.

motifs.broken_grid_cloud: Fuse broken perspective grid into cloud-dyed thread islands, merging them into one rhythm with open regions.
motifs.tidal_ribbons: Interweave two broad sea-flow ribbons and a broken warm accent arc as flat textile regions.
motifs.vector_facets: Interlock three angular trajectory facets with one cool curved counterform; preserve breathing room.

lettering.side_stack: One horizontal condensed word at left, read left-to-right; never stack individual characters.
lettering.right_pillar: One horizontal condensed word at right, read left-to-right; keep clear of the aircraft.
lettering.upper_corner: One horizontal cut-angle word upper-right, read left-to-right; generous clear margin.

collection_grammar: Collection language: identifiable simplified aircraft, bold planar color blocks, selective vivid accents, integrated model glyphs, directional thread, slim embroidered boundary.
